note: English hook formulas for Indian audiences. The field shape (template, example, on-screen line, failure mode, match) follows Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill hooks.json (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Jake Schincariol). The formulas and examples here are original. They are shapes, not facts: replace every rupee figure with a number the user actually gave you, or leave {{amount}} and ask. Do not invent a statistic. On-screen lines are 7 words or fewer. Walk match patterns in classify_order, most specific first.
rules: English only. If the user asks for Hinglish or a regional language, keep the hook in English.
Write the spoken line and the on-screen line separately. On screen is 7 words or fewer.
Use ₹, a city, a date, or a named person. A dollar sign, a 401k, or US slang fails the hook.
Do not invent the rupee figure or the story. If stories.md has no true moment, ask for one.
A finance hook still needs this line nearby: Check this finance or investment claim against current regulations before publishing.

hooks.name: Cost confession
hooks.template: {₹ amount the user stated} is what {one real mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: ₹18,000 is what one missed SIP date cost me.
hooks.failure_mode: A vague cost, or a rupee figure the user never gave you. 'It cost me my peace' is not a number. Leave {{amount}} and ask.

hooks.name: Numbered check
hooks.template: {N} things to check before you {one specific action}.
hooks.example: 3 things to check before you sign a Bengaluru rental agreement.
hooks.failure_mode: A list with no number, or two topics in one hook.

hooks.name: Notice period
hooks.template: {N} days of notice period, and {one concrete consequence}.
hooks.example: 60 days of notice period, and the new offer expires in 10.
hooks.failure_mode: A hustle line with no number of days.

hooks.name: Results day
hooks.example: Board results day: everyone refreshes the page except the person whose roll number it is.
hooks.failure_mode: A rank claim, a cutoff, or a result you invented.

hooks.name: Salary day
hooks.template: Salary lands on the {day}. By the {day}, {one bill} has it.
hooks.example: Salary lands on the 1st. By the 5th, rent has it.
hooks.failure_mode: 'Money goes fast' with no date and no bill.

hooks.name: Two amounts
hooks.template: {Familiar spend} is {amount}. {The habit} is {amount} a month.
hooks.example: Cutting chai versus the cold coffee, once you put your own prices in.
hooks.failure_mode: A US price, or a monthly total the user did not state.

hooks.name: First job
hooks.template: First job in {city}: {one money or work surprise}.
hooks.example: First job in Bengaluru: rent leaves before the PF does.
hooks.failure_mode: A generic graduate pep talk with no city and no bill.

hooks.name: City versus number
hooks.template: {City} {concrete thing}: {number the user stated} versus {number the user stated}.
hooks.example: Bengaluru rent versus the first salary, with your figures only.
hooks.failure_mode: A city used as a joke about the people who live there, or numbers you made up.

hooks.name: The one clause
hooks.example: The one clause in a rental agreement that sets the lock-in.
hooks.failure_mode: A withhold the body never pays off.

hooks.name: Advice with a missing line
hooks.template: {Person} says {common advice}. Here is the line they skip.
hooks.example: Your uncle says put it all in an FD. Here is the line he skips.
hooks.on_screen: The line the FD advice skips
hooks.failure_mode: An invented return, tax rule, or quote. A finance line still needs the regulation-check sentence.

hooks.name: POV callout
hooks.example: POV: your manager who says quick call at 9 pm.
hooks.failure_mode: A POV aimed at nobody the viewer recognises.

hooks.name: Stop this
hooks.example: Stop putting the whole bonus in a savings account.
hooks.failure_mode: Telling people to stop a habit they do not recognise in themselves.

hooks.name: Named forward
hooks.template: Send this to the {person} who {specific habit}.
hooks.example: Send this to the flatmate who signs the rental before reading the lock-in.

hooks.name: Family-group test
hooks.template: Forward this to the family group only if you can say {plain point} out loud.
hooks.example: Forward this to the family group only if you can explain an EMI in one sentence.
hooks.failure_mode: A joke that would embarrass the sender in the family group.

hooks.name: How long it took
hooks.template: I did {specific thing} for {time} before I noticed {concrete result}.
hooks.example: I paid the same OTT apps for 11 months before I added up the UPI debits.
hooks.failure_mode: A confession that did not happen. Ask for a true one and save it in stories.md.

hooks.name: Last line echoes the first
hooks.template: End on the same concrete noun the hook opened with.
hooks.example: The 5th of the month is where the 1st went.
hooks.failure_mode: A loop that does not repeat a concrete noun from the first line.
